name: Rotational Landmine Push Press
instructions: Stand perpendicular to a landmine bar, holding the free end at your shoulder.
Rotate the hips and press the bar up and across your body.
Pivot on the feet as you rotate — power comes from the hips.
Return with control. A rotational power exercise for athletes.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: An advanced barbell press-pattern exercise targeting the abs. Rotational Landmine Push Press builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
